caseQualityDecision: All41 bilingual cases examined individually: plausible mechanisms and conditional limits are adequate; cash-flow-case two demand fields need explicit timing. Market-failure three cases are individually correct but full-goal observable coverage must be made conjunctive.
demonstrationInterpretation: MinimumIndependentDemonstrations=2 is the existing closed profile contract and is not a two-task quota. One substantive multi-step task can supply multiple independent demonstrations. Every required aspect remains required, including all three market-failure mechanisms.

positiveFindings: Real/nominal, total/per-capita and individual distribution remain distinct; 5% nominal growth cannot support 5% individual real consumption. The second case changes judgement dimensions and explicit weights rather than just data values.
goals.boundednessAndRejectedOverclaims: Keine unzulässige universelle Lebensqualitätsrangfolge; unbekannte Bevölkerungsrate wird nicht erfunden.
